name: EXM_CUMUL_MILEAGE_DETERMINANTS
description: This table contains elements that determine cumulative mileage for employees in a business unit and a legal entity.

columns.name: CUMUL_MILEAGE_DETERM_ID
columns.description: Cumulative mileage determinant unique identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier for which cumulative mileage determinants are defined.

columns.name: CUMUL_MILEAGE_PERIOD_CODE
columns.description: Cumulative mileage tracking period, such as Monthly and Annually. Values are from the lookup EXM_CUMUL_MILEAGE_PERIOD.

columns.name: PERIOD_START_MONTH
columns.description: Starting month when cumulative mileage period is Annually. Values are from the lookup MONTH.

columns.name: PERIOD_START_DAY
columns.description: Start day when cumulative mileage period is Annually.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the cumulative mileage determinants are applicable.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date to which the cumulative mileage determinants are applicable.

columns.name: ENABLED_VEH_CATEGORY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether cumulative mileage calculation is by vehicle category.

columns.name: ENABLED_VEH_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether cumulative mileage calculation is by vehicle type.

columns.name: ENABLED_FUEL_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether cumulative mileage calculation is by fuel type.
